task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First off, if it's not too much trouble, I need you to head east. After that, make an effort to venture north. Okay, and then, take a trip east. And then, make an effort to go to the south. After that, try to head west. With that done, make an effort to venture south. And then, go east. With that done, make an effort to venture north. After that, attempt to go west. Next, try to go south. Then, make an attempt to head east. And then, make an effort to travel south. If you can manage that, attempt to move east. And then, go south. And then, make an attempt to go to the south. Then, attempt to go east. Then, venture south. With that done, move south. Once you accomplish that, move west. After that, head west. If you can accomplish that, venture south. And then, venture west. After that, make an attempt to take a trip north. If you can get through with that, attempt to venture west. Okay, and then, attempt to head north. Next, try to venture east. Then, go south. With that done, take a trip south. Next, make an attempt to venture east. With that done, make an attempt to move east. After that, make an effort to head south. And then, make an effort to go to the east. And then, venture north. Then, make an attempt to venture north. After that, move west. After that, venture north. After that, head west. Once you finish that, go to the north. Next, make an attempt to go north. That done, head east. Then, attempt to travel south. Okay, and then, travel east. And then, head east. And then, travel east. With that accomplished, go south. And then, try to head south. And then, venture east. After that, take a trip south. If you can get around to doing that, make an effort to travel east. With that accomplished, move north. Next, head north. Okay, and then, try to go north. And then, try to travel north. And then, travel east. And then, take a trip east. With that over with, attempt to go east. Following that, try to go south. With that over with, move south. Next, attempt to take a trip east. After that, move north. If you can succeed at that, make an attempt to venture west. Following that, retrieve the coin from the floor of the hot canteen. And once you've done that, you win!
